reviews.review:
This has been a massive disapointment.
TLDR: the game wastes time by building artificial progression/grind walls. Unlike in other aRPGs you only need grind (not builds, or skill) and the grind is rarely rewarded.

I enjoyed the gameplay enough to recommend it initially.
I reached 1 grindwall, and overcame it in like 14 hours (had to push my self).

After that I was so lost in chasing checkbox objectives I failed to notice that this is just a grindfest that wastes 100+ hours and doesn't go anywhere. I was literally doing run-and-gun or sand-and-gun against 3 enemy factions for 100+ hours without ANYTHING changing.

By now I cleared the game twice, and the 2nd clear took some grind. Now the game's telling me to do it again AND upgrades cost more. Then (late in game) I got a quest to max all resistance stats on each characters. I never needed that stat and now I have to max it? It's not a challenge - it's just a waste of time.

This game has content for 20-30 hours and you have to only count hours 0-5 and 20-45 to make it all fun. There isn't enough gameplay variety to stretch this into 100+ hours that it tries to do. I don't know what the hell the leads were thinking, but I'm not doing the same crap for the 3rd time and I'm sure as hell not recommending this slop to anyone else.
